hero.title: dadaia-workspace
hero.tagline: Agent-driven SDD ecosystem — spec-driven development with collaborative AI agents.

sections.title: What is it
sections.body: dadaia-workspace is an AI agent ecosystem orchestrated for spec-driven development (SDD). Each agent has a well-defined role and scope — product-engineer, software-engineer, qa-engineer, devops-engineer — and they collaborate through shared specs and contexts.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Most AI development tools treat agents as generic assistants. dadaia-workspace inverts this: each agent knows its boundaries, reads the specs before acting, and never writes code outside its domain. The result is a reproducible, auditable, and secure workflow.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: The operator activates a project context (`dadaia context activate <name>`). Each agent reads the corresponding specs, executes its tasks, and reports back. All agents run on the same LLM but with distinct system prompts and permissions. The project uses Claude (Anthropic) as the base model.

stack.tech: GitHub Actions with OIDC (no long-lived keys)

decisions.title: React/Vite instead of Next.js or Astro
decisions.rationale: High ROI for 5 static routes; no need for SSR or edge rendering.

decisions.title: 2 AWS environments (stage + prod), local dev
decisions.rationale: Explicit gate before prod with no additional cost.

decisions.title: OIDC without long-lived AWS keys
decisions.rationale: No persisted AWS secrets; trust restricted to the portfolio repo.

decisions.title: CMS-lite on the roadmap (not in P0)
decisions.rationale: Future content updates without redeploy, without extra complexity now.
